comments.body: @bar76 ... try Roads and waterways section at Transport for NSW .. if it's not them, someone there should be able to point you in the right direction
@meta4  Who could you notify about the block underpass and fence being compromised who may fix the issue?

Hi
I am adding this observation to a project called Australia's Untold Roadtoll which is gathering road kill data to inform road decisionmaking, such as road design and methods of reducing road kill. Some councils are starting to use the information in iNaturalist to determine their road kill hot spots.

The project is here, in case you would like to join it to add any other road kill or wildlife road injury you see..https://www.inaturalist.org/projects/australia-s-untold-roadtoll-recording-roadkill-and-road-trauma
cheers
katyw
